source: These entries document the features and mechanics of Dynamic Trees.
These entries document the brewing recipes for the potions.
These entries document some trees and their characteristics.
Dirt buckets are used to convert a seed to a sapling and vice versa.$(br2)Place the dirt bucket and the seed or sapling in a crafting table to convert. The recipe is shapeless.
To obtain a dirt bucket simply combine a dirt block with a bucket.$(br2)Right click on the ground with the bucket to empty it, if you need to.
Fruit trees do not drop their seeds, instead you can get them from the fruit.

- Provides nutrients to trees and can be depleted over time.$(br2)- Applying bone meal will increase soil fertility and allows the tree to grow past its mature state.$(br2)- Comparators can be used to sense soil fertility level.
Rooty grass block of a birch tree.
The woodland staff is a creative tool that allows you to copy and paste tree states.$(br2)It can be obtained by using the /dt createstaff command, or by getting it from the creative menu.

You can then set/reset the target species by right clicking a tree, or set/reset the tree and JoCode by shift right clicking a tree.$(br2)JoCodes are the compressed description of a tree's shape and do not depend on species. Using the Woodland Staff will also copy this code to your clipboard.$(br2)Although this is a creative tool, it has an axe harvest level of 3, making it a fast tool for cutting down trees.
This is the brewing recipe for the base potion.$(br2)All other potions from dynamic trees use this during brewing.
This potion replenishes the tree's fertility and causes it to rapidly grow until the soil is dry. The growth effect can be extended for as long as needed by replenishing the fertility every so often.
Particles visible when the tree is under the effect of Burgeoning.
This potion depletes the soil and causes the tree to stop growing.$(br2)Useful to decorate with smaller trees.
Makes the tree grow to a gigantic size. Note that this only works on trees that have mega variants - spruce and jungle by default.$(br1)This is the equivalent of placing saplings in a 2x2 pattern.
A regular spruce tree next to a fully grown mega spruce tree.
This is the brewing recipe for the base transformation potion.$(br2)All other transformation potions use this.
This potion changes an existing tree into another tree species.$(br2)The species of tree depends on the seed you use in the recipe. The example above uses an Oak Acorn.
Apple trees are a fruit tree, and a variant of oak. They spawn in plains biomes by default. These trees will, over time and after maturing, grow apples from the leaves that can be harvested.

The growth of fruit can will depend on the season if a season mod such as Serene Seasons is installed, otherwise it grows year-round.$(br2)Once harvested, to obtain more seeds to replant just use a $(l:mechanics/dirt_bucket)dirt bucket$() to turn your surplus of apples into extra seeds.

Bananas are unique in the fact that they are infertile. This means that despite being a fruit, they cannot be grown into a plant.$(br)To bring one home, one must harvest the fronds from the top, and then craft them with a Dirt Bucket to obtain a banana sucker.$(br)The sucker must be planted in gravel or sand, and will only grow while raining even if bone meal is used.$(br)Banana plants can be found in both jungles and beaches.

- Trees grow progressively from seeds to mature trees over time, growing around obstacles in a natural way.$(br2)- Trees have growth rate and mature sizes that are biome, temperature and rainfall dependent.$(br2)- Thin branches can be climbed like ladders.

- Their growth can be sped up with the use of bone meal, which also replenishes the $(l:mechanics/rooty_soil)soil's fertility$().$(br2)- Trees drop seeds at random that can potentially plant themselves.$(br2)- Trees won't grow in darkness. Leaves not connected to an outer tree branch or starved of light will die. Outer branches without leaves slowly rot away.

- Walking on leaves blocks is slow and you sink slightly on them. Falling onto leaves prevents fall damage but destroys the leaf blocks.$(br2)- There are unique new species for fruits, such as $(l:trees/apple_tree)apple trees$().$(br2)- Falling trees can do a lot of damage if they hit something, so be careful!
A falling tree killing a pig

The Nether is no stranger to tree-like flora. Immense crimson fungi populate the crimson forests, while their warped fungus cousins can be found in the elusive warped forest.$(br2)Bright bulbs of shroomlight generate underneath both of them, lighting up the gloomy undergrounds.

The caps from these fungi can be harvested from sprouting shrooms in the crimson and warped forests. They can be planted on their respective nylium and given a spark of bone meal to grow more.$(br2)Once the tree has started growing, it is not required to continue using bone meal for the tree to reach maturity.

By default Dynamic Trees can be found all over the overworld populating the surface in almost every biome.$(br2)Oak trees are large and sturdy while birch trees and tall and thin. Explore the world to find a variety of different species and their unique shapes.

Some of these trees can be home to honey bees, so be careful when lumbering to not disturb these fuzzy workers.$(br2)A nest also has a chance to appear on an oak or birch tree while one is naturally growing, if flowers are nearby.
A bee nest on a birch tree

This section provide descriptions about this mod's concept and information.
This section provide descriptions about actions added by ParCool. There are tons of different abilities in the Parcool arsenal. let's see how to use them!
This section provides descriptions about miscellanious parkour features added by Parcool.

Thanks for playing this mod!$(br2)This mod is a Minecraft Forge mod for more $(bold)Cool$() actions like $(bold)Parkour$()$(br)Some actions are actually techniques of parkour.$(br2)Now you become a parkour-player. Let's run around the Minecraft World!

$(italic)Parkour$() is a kind of sports, organized by $(italic)David Belle$().$(br)Parkour is an activity that humans move to another point quickly as possible by oneself.$(br2)The name comes from $(italic)parcours$() of French, and the players called $(italic)Traceur$().$(br)Sometimes Parkour is called $(italic)Free Running$(). This is said to be a English translation of Parkour.
This is a list of Mod developers and Translators.$(br2)I also appreciate contributions by people not listed.

This mod adds a concept of Stamina to game.$(br2)Stamina is consumed when you do ParCool moves. When you run out of stamina, penalty is imposed on you.$(list)Disable to sprint and be slow down$(list)Disable most of ParCool actions$(br)Please be careful.
$(bold)Breakfalls$() are skills to protect us from impact of landing.$(br2) 2 types of breakfall are implemented : $(bold)Roll$() and $(bold)Safety Tap$().

$(bold)Roll$() is one of the Breakfalls. It change an impact of landing into energy of rolling.$(br2)This is sometimes misunderstood, but the $(italic)Roll$() of parkour is landing technique, so ParCool's roll is also used only when you land.
$(list)Land while you press forward or backward movement key and Breakfall($(k:parcool.Breakfall)) Key
$(bold)Safety Tap$() is one of the Breakfalls. It absorb an impact by bending your legs.$(br2)By the way how can Steve bend his legs?

$(bold)Catleap$() is a skill used to jump and cling to top of walls,fence or etc.$(br)This is said to be one of basic skills of parkour.$(br)Traceurs absorb an impact of landing with movement of legs.$(br2)In this mod, this is implemented as a long jump. Please careful with the cool time.

$(bold)1.$() Do $(l:parcool:actions/fast_run)Fast Run$()$(br)$(bold)2.$() Sneak quickly$(br)$(bold)3.$() Cancel sneaking quickly$(br2)I recommend also using $(l:parcool:actions/cling_to_cliff)Cling To Cliff$().
You can use $(bold)Charge Jump$() for jumping up higher.$(br)This helps you get over fences and climb high wall.$(br2)Though a simple skill, it should be helpful for you!
$(bold)1.$() Stand in place and sneak for few seconds $(br)$(bold)2.$() Release shift key and press jump key simultaneously.
You can climb pole-like blocks, such as stacked fences, chains, iron bars and etc.
You can cling to edge of blocks and stay there. Of course, it is possible to move although slowly.$(br) You can also climb up onto the blocks by pressing jump key.
$(list) Press Cling-To-Cliff Key($(k:parcool.ClingToCliff)) by a wall$(br)
You can crawl everywhere and go through narrow course.$(br)Please check also $(l:parcool:actions/slide)Slide$().
ParCool has special jumping animation: $(bold)Diving$(). Let's see it by third-person view. In addition by pressing jump key again after a few seconds, Dive goes Sky-Diving.
$(bold)1.$() Do $(l:parcool:actions/fast_run)Fast Run$()$(br)$(bold)2.$() Jump into enough space from a high place
$(bold)Dodge$() is action for avoiding bullets or arrows. You can quickly move short distance. $(br)However be careful with cool time!
$(list)Press movement keys twice(impossible with forward key)$(list)Press movement key and Dodge key($(k:parcool.Dodge))
Now you are an parkour player! so you can run faster than before. This is a basis of ParCool. Some other actions need using this.
$(list) Continue to press Fast Run key($(k:parcool.FastRun)) during sprinting
Also you can swim faster than before : $(bold)Fast Swim$(). It contains original animation.$(br2)Its operation is same as one of Fast Run.
$(list) Continue to press Fast Run key($(k:parcool.FastRun)) during sprinting
ParCool adds a special animation of jump: $(bold)Flipping$().$(br2) You can do front-flip and back-flip.
$(list)Press left and right movement key simultaneously$(list)Press Flipping key($(k:parcool.Flipping))
You can hang on some blocks like chains or end rods.$(br2)It's also possible to move and jump forward by pressing jump key.
$(list) Press Hang Down Key($(k:parcool.HangDown)) below horizontal thin blocks$(br)

It's possible to hide in blocks.$(br2)Hiding players get harder to find by enemies. Name is also hidden from other players.$(br2)These below blocks is you can hide in$(list)Leaves block$(list)Hay block
$(list) Press Hide-In-Block Key($(k:parcool.HideInBlock)) while sneaking near blocks you want to hide in

You can run horizontally sticking to wall. This should help you to jump to a distance platform.$(br2)Although Sometimes misunderstood, the technique of $(l:actions/wall_run)Wall Run$() is vertical one, not horizontal.
$(bold)1.$() Do $(l:parcool:actions/fast_run)Fast Run$() in air along the wall$(br)$(bold)2.$() Continue to press Wall-Run Key($(k:parcool.HorizontalWallRun))
Sometimes you may want to turn quickly backward. Press only one key to do it.
$(bold)Slide$() is an action derived from $(l:parcool:actions/crawl)Crawl$(). You can go through narrow space quickly.
$(bold)Vault$() is skills used to get over obstacles like fences.$(br)There are numerous variations. In this game, you can use $(italic)Speed Vault$() and $(italic)Kong Vault$()
Wall Jump, is a skill to jump more by kicking wall. You need to have your back to the wall.$(br)However, you cannot gain height when kicking icy blocks!
$(list)Press Wall-Jump key($(k:parcool.WallJump)) by walls in air

$(bold)Wall Run$() is a technique to jump vertically using a wall, to get over it.$(br)Don't mistake this for $(l:actions/horizontal_wall_run)Horizontal Wall Run$().$(br)$(br)Please note that you fail wall running if the wall is made of slippery material like ice block.

$(bold)1.$() Look above horizontal line and take running up with $(l:parcool:actions/fast_run)Fast Run$()$(br)$(bold)2.$() Jump onto wall with not releasing jump key.$(br)$(br)It may be little difficult but try it.
You can fall slowly by cling to wall. This action is affected by the slipperiness of blocks, so players cannot make fall slow with wall of ice block.
$(list)Press Wall Slide key($(k:parcool.WallSlide)) by walls in air
You frequently run out of your stamina? Let's $(strike)modify config$() make $(bold)Energy Drink$(). You can do ParCool moves without consuming stamina!
Energy Drinks can be made with brewing stand.$(br2)The recipe is$(list)[Awkward Potion] + [Nether Quartz]$(list)[Poor Quality Energy Drink] + [Nether Quartz]

Poor Quality Energy Drinks is low quality version of Energy Drink. This is easy to making but have some bad effects.$(br2)The recipe is$(list)[Awkward Potion] + [Poisonous Potato]$(list)[Awkward Potion] + [Chicken]
ParCool adds some passive abilities and animations.
New animation for long-time falling is added. If you think this is annoying, you can turn it off by config.
Zipline is a parkour facility, this connects distant 2 points and enable players to move from one side to other end.
First please decide 2 point to set zipline. Then we have to place Zipline Hooks at each place.$(br2)There are 2 types zipline hook. Wooden one and one made by Iron.

Did you place hooks? Then next let's craft Zipline Rope. Use the item while sneaking to change rope tension.$(br2)To set zipline, use zipline rope to 2 zipline hook. Then the 2 point should be connected by zipline
$(list) Jump to approach zipline and to press Ride-Zipline Key($(k:parcool.RideZipline))

Dynamic Trees Completely overhauls vanilla trees by replacing them with trees that grow over time and are aware of their surroundings during growth. Dynamic Trees also look more realistic with branches and trunks.
